primary_rules.ecbd: supplied binarized activity and HepG2 labels
primary_rules.coadd: exact ID and supplied-standardized structure agreement; unanimous E. coli hit observations; CC50 interval classified at matched antibacterial dose
primary_rules.drh: growth-inhibition hits; exact isomeric molecular identity between paired assays; unanimous observed toxicity
primary_rules.duplicate_policy: one canonical isomeric molecule per organism; conflicts in labels or saved scores excluded
primary_rules.threshold: predicted toxic if score strictly greater than cutoff
primary_rules.kde: SciPy gaussian_kde with Scott bandwidth; no boundary correction
primary_rules.chemical_space: shared chemical_space.py analysis supplied by repository figure infrastructure

limits: Cohort selection and prediction-version assumptions are recorded in primary_rules.
Each source uses its recorded assay definition and exposure conditions.
Similarity filters use the specified exclusion policy and reference cohort.
DMAX_AVE is retained as source metadata.
Statistics are calculated from the selected compound-level records.
